classic.a: A classic layout still needs a short summary and clear results.

creative.w: Designers, content creators and other visual roles that send resumes directly.

minimalist.w: Senior professionals and anyone who prefers a calm, modern design.

corporate.w: Large company roles in operations, finance, HR and sales.

one-page.w: Freshers and professionals with up to about 5 years of experience.

two-column.w: Experienced candidates with many skills, certifications or languages to show.

with-photo.w: Roles where a photo is common, such as hospitality, airlines, modelling and some Gulf job applications.

fresher.w: Students and recent graduates with little or no work experience.

experienced.w: Professionals with a few years of work and results they can show.

Experience first, with one result in most bullets
Skills that match the job post
experienced.a: Keep job titles, company names and dates in plain text so the software can read your history in order.
